source_caption_text:
Me pulling up to her window with Future lyrics instead of an apology hoping she lets me in

Future’s “All to Myself” is the kind of song that makes you think you can win someone back just by quoting a few lyrics. With his signature melodic delivery and emotional approach, he turns relationship drama into something you can sing along to, even when you’re the one who messed things up.

It has that late-night feel that makes you want to pull up outside her window and start singing every word, hoping she’ll hear you out. Of course, using Future lyrics as your apology probably isn’t the most reliable plan, but that won’t stop anyone from trying.

Sometimes all you need is the right Future song to convince yourself you’ve still got a chance. Whether you’re genuinely trying to make things right or just performing outside her house like it’s a music video, “All to Myself” fits the moment.
